# Nile ICT Solutions
> Technology that keeps business moving.

## Entity Overview
- Official Name: Nile ICT Solutions
- Brand Message: Technology that keeps business moving.
- Positioning: Enterprise ICT infrastructure, commercial cybersecurity, custom business software, and contracted SLA IT management.
- Headquarters: Tom Mboya Street, Posta Building, Nairobi CBD, Kenya
- Direct Contact Phone: +254 795 121 583
- Official Email: info@nileictsolutions.com

## Core Solution Pillars
1. ICT Infrastructure & Security: Structured Cat6A and single/multimode fiber cabling, server rack management, Cisco/Mikrotik routing, commercial IP CCTV surveillance with H.265+ NVR storage, biometric access control, and KDPA-compliant data security.
2. Enterprise Systems & Software: Custom and integrated core banking platforms, SACCO/microfinance transaction engines, insurance policy management, ERP workflows, and Safaricom MPESA Daraja API integration.
3. Digital Solutions & Web Engineering: Next.js modern web applications, high-converting corporate portals, and custom B2B web software.
4. Business Technology Support: Contracted Managed IT Services backed by strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs), sub-2-hour remote response, sub-4-hour on-site Nairobi dispatch, and scheduled preventative maintenance.

## Verified Partner References
- Century Bank: Mission-critical banking hall cabling, server room rack consolidation, and zero-downtime power resilience.
- Sote Hub: High-density campus Wi-Fi 6 wireless deployment and multi-SSID bandwidth management.
- The Cradle Tented Camp: Turnkey long-range outdoor wireless mesh and remote IP surveillance.
